Title: Azure Container Registry—Buildpacks support in Tasks is now in preview

Body.Content:
Buildpacks support with Container Registry tasks is now in preview. Buildpacks simplify adding the code to a particular stack, giving you the benefit of deploying containers without having to manage the details of building images. 

Learn more
